titre: Conteneurs partis par le rail au port de New York et New Jersey
sous_titre: conteneurs acheminés par voie ferrée, par mois, janvier à mai 2026

Janvier 2026.texte: A total of 58,522 containers moved through the Port of New York and New Jersey by rail in January 2026.

Février 2026.texte: February's rail volume increased 9.5 percent from the previous year's figure as a total of 56,544 containers moved by rail.

Mars 2026.texte: Rail volume surged 37 percent from the previous year's March figure, totaling 80,914 containers.

Avril 2026.texte: Rail volume decreased 8.5% in April 2026 from the April 2025 figure, totaling 54,538 containers.

Mai 2026.texte: May's rail volume decreased 8.3% from the previous year, totaling 58,821 containers.
